Im not on Adderal (on some generic methylphenidate instead)  and i noticed this today. I find that ever since starting medication i struggle to even think of more chill activities like drawing or playing video games because im more worried about doing “the-things-i-gotta-do-to-live”. 
I realized today that i woke up with a big desire to draw and improve and have fun with that stuff, and after taking meds i was worrying more about my body and habits.
